title: Preset-aware MCP tool families leave the header
requirement: Each preset must receive only the MCP tool families its job needs, and the restriction must remove schemas from the derived request header rather than merely refusing calls: Playwright only for standard/orchestrator/ux, Godot only for standard and backend/ux/reviewer/critic inside a Godot workspace, research/docs no MCP family, and Hindsight never hidden.
reason: The proof is a live request/header from a real DSH web server (headless and browser sessions), which needs a second server plus a model turn per preset; there is no test file that can encode it without reimplementing the harness's header derivation.
steps: Boot a second 0.2.1 server on :3081 with the kit profile (tool-families row mounted) and, for the research case, a temporary overlay setting agent-preset-registry default to research.
Create a fresh session in the dsh-kit workspace and send one trivial prompt so a request is derived.
Read the session log ($DSH_HOME/sessions/<slug>/<id>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd, zstd -dc) and inspect request/header -> data.header.tools[].
Count families: mcp__playwright__*, mcp__godot__*, any other mcp__*, hindsight_*.
expected: A fresh orchestrator session's request/header keeps mcp__playwright__* and carries no mcp__godot__* outside a Godot checkout; a fresh research session carries NO mcp__ family at all; both keep all 8 hindsight_* tools.

history.notes: Godot live-kept could not be shown on the probe server: the Godot AI bridge binds a port :3080 already holds (`ATTACH_START_FAILED`), so godot was absent from every header. The Godot half is proven by the decision proof over the real 107-tool header (backend/ux/reviewer/critic keep it only where project.godot exists; orchestrator/research/docs never), not by a live header. Playwright removal and hindsight retention ARE live header evidence. Second server stopped, probe sessions deleted; :3080 untouched.
